briefs.brief: Thesis is strengthening (live since 2026-08-20); ladder rank 3, laggard, in AI Memory/Storage (live 09-20; rank was 3 on 09-09 too). The desk reads the laggard rank as a classification artifact, not a sell case: post-SanDisk, WDC is purely nearline HDD with zero DRAM/NAND/HBM (desk Q&A, secondary, 09-20). Cluster mean was +7.99% vs WDC -4.49% over a month. Evidence for: FY26 Q4 beat, +45% YoY revenue guided (08-05, secondary). Against: fell ~11% after hours on that beat. Open proposals stack: accepted P-149 $150 plus open P-344 $500 = $650, 51.1% of the position (09-17).
key_points: Laggard rank is a classification verdict, not a sell case (09-20, secondary)
policy.json has no Storage/HDD cluster target; adding one is recommended, not done; WDC now also listed in AI Storage/HDD (09-21)
Rebound BUY $500 amended from P-280, support $413.92 (09-15); stop floored near swing-low support (09-16)
Stacking: P-149 + P-344 = $650, 51.1% of current WDC position (09-17)
Superseded: 09-09 rank-3 rationale (+39.3% target gap, best mover) replaced by the 09-20 classification rationale
open_questions: Should a Storage/HDD cluster target be added to policy.json so WDC can be reassigned out of AI Memory/Storage?
Does the stacked $650 buy on WDC stay within intent given both proposals execute?
Is the thesis text still right, given it says NAND/enterprise-SSD while WDC now has no NAND?
contradictions: Live thesis line (08-20, 09-15) says 'NAND/enterprise-SSD+nearline-HDD... judged on NAND/HDD', but the 09-20 fact says WDC has zero NAND post-SanDisk; the thesis wording was not updated in the input.
Cluster weight reads differ: 6.46% vs 16% band top (09-16), 4.4% vs 10% target (09-15), 14.3% of total book (09-16); denominators or scopes are not stated.
The 09-16 observation calls the fall cluster-wide, while the same-day rebound note cannot verify it because the MU comparison was unavailable (macro tag provisional).

briefs.brief: Thesis is WATCH (live 2026-09-21), downgraded from strengthening (08-31) to watch on 09-14; ladder rank 3 in Compute/Hyperscaler (moved from 2 on 09-15). WATCH rests on 1m peer underperformance, -7.2pp vs XLK (-1.44 sigma) on 09-21, narrowed from -7.81pp on 09-19, offset by partnership tailwinds (Qualcomm, OpenAI ad deal). Mean target $328.17 is about 29% above the $254.15 close (n=40, 09-18). Position was added (+2sh 09-18) into WATCH, now 5sh / 3.66% of equity (09-21). All observations are secondary.
key_points: Peer gap -7.2pp vs XLK 09-21, from -7.81pp 09-19; no catch-up (day move 0.15x ATR)
Correction: the 09-14 gap of -3.30pp was superseded; the 09-19 figure is -7.81pp (-1.55 sigma)
Buy added while thesis is WATCH and the gap widened: flagged as sizing ahead of thesis resolution (09-18)
Quality flag 08-30: capex $44.2B exceeded OCF $26.03B; FCF -$18.17B; LT debt +81.4% YoY to $119.07B
open_questions: Will Q3 show AWS growth accelerating faster than capex, or capex held flat? (bench entry condition, 09-08)
Does AWS reach >=40% growth in Q3, which the 09-15 rank note says would close the gap to GOOG?
Does the peer laggard status persist or catch up?
contradictions: 09-08 bench note says ~$200B of 2026 capex is funded from operating cash flow with no dilution, and the superseded 08-31 thesis says funded by retail cash flow; the 08-30 quality flag says capex exceeded OCF and the quarter was funded by debt issuance.
Superseded 09-14 rank note called AMZN the only major not self-funding, while the live 09-15 rank note cites the largest target gap among majors and a diversifying retail business as offsets.

briefs.brief: Cluster thesis is INTACT (mid), downgraded from strengthening on 2026-09-15. Demand evidence is unchanged (GEV, BE, VRT all raised FY26 guidance), but two facts show backlog is not near-term margin: GLJ's vintage math puts GEV's 2027 deliveries at ~3pp backlog margin vs 10-11pp on 2028, and VRT missed Q2 revenue by ~$110M on timing. Live ranks 09-15: BE 1, GEV 2, VRT 3; VST 4 and FSLR 5 stand from 09-09. Falsifiers: GEV Q3 (10-28) orders down QoQ, VRT Q3 (10-21) book-to-bill <1.0, or a top-4 hyperscaler cutting 2027 capex before 11-15. All secondary.
key_points: Downgrade strengthening to intact 09-15: margin timing, not demand (GLJ vintage math; VRT Q2 miss)
BE rank 1 case against: ~95x FY26 EPS, +190% YTD, beta 1.68; its ~$14B long-dated backlog vintage lag is untested, no source
Reorder triggers: VRT Q3 10-21 in line/beat and book-to-bill >=1.2 moves VRT above GEV; US10Y >5.25% before 10-15 likely costs BE rank 1
Margin pool moving toward scarce long-lead generation (GEV 2028+) and on-site power (BE); away from in-hall assembly and pre-2025 fixed-price backlog
Bench: ETN, PWR, CEG, VST, each with a stated entry condition
open_questions: Does a second sell-side shop publish a vintage backlog-margin cut on VRT, ETN or BE before 10-31, making the mechanism cluster-wide?
Does the VST Texas data-center-pause overhang (09-09) still apply? It was not re-checked 09-15.
Does ETN Q3 show data-center orders with price realization? The date is TBD.
contradictions: Live ladder_order (09-09) reads GEV > BE > VRT > VST > FSLR, but live 09-15 ranks put BE at 1 and GEV at 2.
GEV Q3 print date is 2026-10-21 in the 09-09 falsifier and reorder note, but 2026-10-28 in the 09-15 notes (10-21 is VRT).
VRT rank-3 laggard is called contestable (short-dated backlog so the GLJ mechanism barely applies, +42% target upside), while the cluster downgrade leans on the same GLJ vintage math.
